visibleCharacterRule: strip style, script, markup and collapse whitespace

system-or-conversation-snapshot.change: add one delayed message or recovered local reference

administrative-index.change: add one permission-specific row without replacing public content

social-forum-record.change: add one timestamped reply, quote, or changed account field

news-article.change: add one correction, source link, or later publication note

ritual-record.change: add one provenance annotation or later transcription layer

local-file-snapshot.change: add original-path metadata and one comparison target

ending-snapshot.change: expose as historical cadence reference after completion only

staged-chat-script.change: append the next message sequence idempotently

map-record.change: add one previously unlabeled location reference

reference-page.change: add one traceable citation or later metadata record
